title: [LOGGED OUT] "Special offers" section shows the three welcome bundles with prices

steps.text: Open https://site.ludus-game.com/store in the browser and wait until the page has finished loading.
If a "How we use cookies" banner is shown, click "Dismiss".
steps.saw: Banner shown; clicked Dismiss; banner gone

steps.text: Scroll down to the "Special offers" heading.
steps.saw: Scrolled down 500px (overshot), then up 420px; Special offers heading visible at top of screen

steps.text: Is the "Small welcome bundle" card shown with "Available: 1/1" and a green USD price button?
steps.saw: Small welcome bundle card, Available: 1/1, green button USD 5.40 (old price 5.99)

steps.text: Click the "Next offer" arrow if "Medium welcome bundle" is not visible. Do not click a price button.
steps.saw: Medium was not visible; clicked Next offer once; carousel started sliding

steps.text: Is the "Medium welcome bundle" card shown with a green USD price button?
steps.saw: Medium welcome bundle card with green button USD 54.00 (old 59.99)

steps.text: Click the "Next offer" arrow if "Big welcome bundle" is not visible.
steps.saw: Big was not visible; clicked Next offer once; carousel sliding to Big

steps.text: Is the "Big welcome bundle" card shown with a green USD price button?
steps.saw: Big welcome bundle card with green button USD 108.00 (old 119.99)
